title: PostgreSQL & Database Design
description: Master relational database modeling, normalization, B-Tree and GIN indexes, EXPLAIN query plans, ACID transactions, JSONB, CTEs, and window functions.
outcomes: Design normalized 3NF schemas with foreign keys and check constraints
Read EXPLAIN plans and choose composite, partial, and covering indexes
Prevent race conditions using transactions, isolation levels, and row locks
Write production analytics queries using CTEs, window functions, and JSONB
